blends.name: Kavian - Silver
blends.desc:
Kavian is a planet within the Alien Worlds game. The Council of the Kavian-based Syndicate and the LD2 asset-backed crypto protocol present a collection of NFTs backed by Trilium (TLM) and LD2 physical silver (XLDZ).

This blend, managed by LD2, allows landownders to turn their TLM-backed reward NFTs into silver-backed NFTs, which can be redeemed for physical silver per LD2's standard business practices. Note, this is not a whitelisted drop, so any account holding the Trilium-backed NFTs can blend them for silver. One hundred (100) TLM-backed NFTs are needed to blend for one (1) XLDZ-backed NFT. The XLDZ-backed NFTs is backed by one troy ounce of 999 fine silver, securely vaulted in a Las Vegas, NV vault. The silver is 100% transferable on-chain, and 100% redeemable per LD2's standard business practices. (Visit https://wax.ld2coin.io and https://ld2coin.io for more information.)

For more information, see the Medium article: https://medium.com/@interplanetaryfederation/tlm-backed-nft-drop-announcement-for-kavian-landholders-1e39d91d389f
